St Albans Cathedral. Monument to William Payne King (1706-1766) of Fineshade Abbey, Northamptonshire. He married Anne Maria Colebrooke (a daughter of w:James Colebrooke (1680-1752), mercer, banker, and Citizen of London, and a sister of Sir James Colebrooke, 1st Baronet (1722-1761) of Gatton, Surrey) who in 1769 remarried to w:Edwin Sandys, 2nd Baron Sandys (1726-1797). Heraldry King ( Ermine, on a chevron engrailed .... 3 .... ) impaling: Gules, a lion rampant ermine ducally crowned or on a chief of the last three martlets proper (Burke, Sir Bernard, The General Armory, London, 1884, p.213 "C
